messages:
alyssa: FYI PR merged https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/487 but I just spotted model-catalog/zephyrx.md still lists context_limit: 4096. Our infra tests show 8192. Can docs patch the card? @mike @jordan

mike: Ack — I updated the runtime page earlier and missed the card. I'll open a follow-up PR to correct the limit and add a small note about safe capacity. Any specific bench numbers to include?

jordan: From yesterday's run: ZephyrX-16GB (quant q8_0) ~120 tok/s @ seq=1024, batch=8. 95th tail ~85ms. I can add a tiny bench row under "Performance": "~120 tok/s @ seq=1024 (batch 8), 95th ~85ms — NVIDIA A10G, quant profile q8_0"

sam: We should also clarify the wording around "context_limit" vs "max_input_length" — folks keep confusing which includes prompt+response. Recommend a 1-line table: param name | meaning.

lisa: Also noticed the quickstart SDK snippet uses the old param name `max_tokens`. For v2 we should show `max_new_tokens`. Proposed snippet below to paste into quickstart:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="zephyrx", input="Summarize...", max_new_tokens=512)
print(resp.output)
```

mike: Good catch. I'll update quickstart and the Python/TS snippets. I'll also add a short migration note: "max_tokens -> max_new_tokens" and call out embeddings signature change.

doc-bot: checklist: 1) update model card limits + add bench row; 2) replace SDK snippet in quickstart + add migration note; 3) fix broken compat link if present; 4) date-stamp benches and add hardware. Please add GH assignees.

jordan: There's a broken link to the runtime compat matrix at docs/reference/compat.md#quantized (404). I fixed it in a local branch but will wait to push until the card/quickstart edits land to avoid collisions.

alyssa: Plan: mike opens PR for card + quickstart. jordan adds bench table and fixes link. lisa will update SDK snippet and migration note. I'll review and merge tonight. Assign in GH when ready.

mike: pinging @kevin from runtime to confirm 8192 is correct for ZephyrX. Kevin?

kevin: Confirmed — runtime kernel supports 8192 for ZephyrX on our Zephyr kernel on A10G within expected mem limits. We'll add a runtime note referencing the kernel version.

sam: Small style nit: round numbers in the card (e.g., "~120 tok/s") and include hardware and quant profile column.

jordan: Will include hardware + quant profile q8_0 and add date: 2024-06-14. Aiming to open PR by 13:30 PT.

mike: I'll hold off merging until your bench table is in to minimize churn. :thumbsup:

alyssa: Awesome — thanks everyone. Once merged I'll update the model-catalog index and add a short release note to the docs changelog.

mike: quick TODOs for GH: assign @mike for quickstart, @jordan for bench & linkfix, @lisa for SDK snippet/migration. I'll add labels docs/bugfix docs/patch.

doc-bot: reminder: add the exact command used for benches to the card (e.g., `python bench.py --model zephyrx --batch 8 --seq 1024`) for reproducibility.
